digest.component_or_area: Jira DC field readiness unit test
propositions: The test stubs /rest/api/2/field to omit Epic Link, causing the readiness poll to expire against the full 120-second production budget instead of failing deterministically.
The test currently sleeps ~120 real seconds while making ~120 stub reads, burning the entire FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S production constant in a unit test.
Setting JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT to 0 via monkeypatch makes the poll loop deterministic: exactly one attempt before monotonic() >= deadline breaks without calling sleep.
An assertion that exactly one /rest/api/2/field read occurs serves as a guard that proves the expiry path ran without sleeping, robust against changes and independent of wall-clock timing.

The same environment-variable pattern is already used in the sibling test suite (tests/unit/test_live_jira_dc_conftest.py:296) and avoids being silently defeated by ambient JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT values.
